## About
Houston Plumbing Expert works out of Hillmont St in northwest Houston. We handle residential and commercial plumbing under one roof, so one call covers your home or your business.
Houston pipes have it rough with shifting soil, aging lines and storm damage. We find the root cause, explain it in plain words, and give you an estimate before any work starts. Got an emergency? We're available around the clock.
We're rated 5 on Google from 146 reviews, and reviewers mention our plumbers Eric and Elmer by name.

## Services
- Residential Plumbing: From a dripping faucet to a full pipe replacement. We listen, diagnose carefully and explain the fix before we start.
- Commercial Plumbing: Offices, restaurants, retail spaces and industrial facilities. We fix the real problem and keep disruption to a minimum.
- Emergency Plumbing: Burst pipes and sewage backups don't wait for business hours. We respond fast to stop the damage.
- Under Slab Plumbing: Houston's clay soil is hard on pipes under your foundation. We pinpoint the problem and keep the repair targeted.
- Leak Detection: Electronic sensors, acoustic detection, thermal imaging and video inspection cameras. Less guesswork, more targeted repairs.
- Drain Services: Slow, smelly or gurgling drains. We inspect and clean drain lines for homes and businesses.
- Water Heater Repairs & Installation: Repairs and full installs on all major brands and unit types, whether your unit is leaking or past its prime.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer free estimates?
A: Yes. Call us to set up your free estimate.

Q: When are you open?
A: Every day, Monday through Sunday. We offer 24 hour plumbing service.

Q: Is financing available?
A: Depending on your project, yes. Our team will walk you through the application.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Houston and the surrounding area, including Katy, Sugar Land, Spring, The Woodlands and Pasadena.
